generatedArt.prompt: Use case: reusable game UI asset atlas for an original 1930s Art Deco underwater city interface study, not an official BioShock asset. Square 3-by-3 sprite atlas of nine separate isolated objects on a truly transparent background with wide gutters: small amber tonic bottle with brass cap, cobalt serum vial, stylized brass key, circular mechanical dial, fan-shaped Art Deco sunburst medallion, cream enamel vending token, compact brass pressure gauge, blank vertical elevator plaque, tiny oxidized copper gear. Art Deco illustration: precise stepped geometry, symmetrical fan rays, blackened bronze, warm brass, aged ivory enamel, restrained sea-green patina; polished but not photoreal, finely engraved lines, consistent upper-left light. No characters, no architecture background, no words, no logos, no guns, no glow. Keep each object separate and fully visible; preserve actual transparent alpha.
